_comment: Product source files permitted to exceed the 1000-line limit. POLICY-OWNED: the contents are set by
the reviewer, not inferred from whatever happens to be oversized today. Adding a path here is a
decision; removing one is just bookkeeping after a file is cleared.
Approved by comms-senior-dev on 2026-08-13, verbatim: 'Allowlist should be explicit and policy-owned,
not inferred from whatever is currently oversized. The currently justified product allowlist is the
ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH, read by both gates -- service/tests/test_no_new_oversized_source_file.py and
mcp/stdio/tests/no-new-oversized-source-file.test.js. Two copies of a list like this is the forked-
constant class the whole v0.5.x series has been removing; a duplicated allowlist would drift silently
and each gate would then enforce a different policy.
PATHS, NOT BASENAMES. The first version of these gates matched on basename, which would have exempted
any file called app.js or server.js anywhere in the tree. Repo-relative, forward slashes.
Both gates fail if a listed path no longer exists or has dropped below the limit, so this list shrinks
honestly and cannot rot into names nobody re-checked.
